E0764

Call argument labels a parameter the callee does not have (D-APILABEL1)

What

Call argument labels a parameter the callee does not have (D-APILABEL1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0764

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0764: tests/ui/builtin_method_label_unknown.stderr.

Error [E0764]: `map` has no parameter labelled `bogus`
  --> tests/ui/builtin_method_label_unknown.jet:1:28
    |
  1 | fn run() { _ :: [1, 2].map(bogus: (n: Int) -> n) }
    |                            ^^^^^
 Why: a label binds an argument to the parameter of that name
 Fix: `map` takes no labelled arguments
